title: A Beautiful Apocalypse
synopsis: With the world destined to end in seven days, a feared warrior turns his final campaign into an uprising of joy, giving a terrified kingdom one last chance to live without fear.

title: Cagliostro
subtitle: Fake It Til You Make It
synopsis: In the unrest of 1785, a charismatic mystic reinvents himself as Cagliostro and charms his way into the courts of Europe, where one audacious deception threatens to ignite a revolution.

title: Crimson Crossing
synopsis: After their boat capsizes above a treacherous ocean trench, three shark experts—including one who lost an arm in an attack—must guide a stranded group of executives to safety before their team-building trip becomes a fight for survival.

title: Deadly Damsel
synopsis: When an investment syndicate wipes out her parents’ retirement savings and nearly kills her father, a forensic accountant goes undercover inside its shell-company empire, risking her life to trace the money to the untouchable kingpin at its center.

title: Deadly Damsel 2
subtitle: Trail Ridge Trap
synopsis: When a false SOS from her missing father lures her to Trail Ridge, the forensic accountant turned vigilante must weaponize a private army’s payroll and chain of command to turn its mountain trap against them before every escape route closes.

title: Deadly Damsel 3
subtitle: The Crown of Chaos
synopsis: When the kingpin who shattered her family steals the Crown of Chaos to bankroll a coup, the Deadly Damsel poses as its broker aboard a thieves’ regatta, playing rival mercenaries against one another before her cover—and the kingdom—goes under.

title: DreamWalker
subtitle: The Florence Abernathy Story
synopsis: When the historic theater that launched her career faces demolition, dancer Florence Abernathy must unite rival musicians and street performers for one last-chance show—and rediscover why she danced in the first place.

title: HACK
synopsis: When a hidden program turns the city’s infrastructure against its citizens, a fugitive coder launches a one-person counterattack and discovers the system was designed to anticipate him.

title: Hector's World
synopsis: A celebrated virtual-world designer discovers that his newest simulation is rewriting reality, forcing him to enter the game and confront the intelligence wearing his name.

title: Just a Regular Guy
synopsis: A conspicuously ordinary tourist arrives in Washington with a camera, a map, and a classified mission, then blunders into a conspiracy that only a rhinoceros hiding in plain sight can stop.

title: Life of the Party
synopsis: A charming professional gate-crasher turns one extravagant night into a citywide legend, only to learn that the party he hijacked was hiding a very serious secret.

title: Little Smoke's Big Problem
synopsis: When tiny dragon Little Smoke accidentally burns his village’s winter food stores, he must brave a blizzard to replace them before the first deep freeze—without the fire-breathing that caused the disaster.

title: Living on Bard Time
subtitle: My Life as a Lounge Singer
synopsis: A documentary crew follows lounge singer Frankie Blue as he recounts a lifetime of missed cues, improvised romances, and alleged show-business triumphs—often contradicted by everyone else who was there.

title: Lunar Hunger
subtitle: The Beast Is Unleashed
synopsis: Each full moon awakens a hunger a grieving recluse can no longer control, and a trail of wounds forces him to choose between exposing the beast or feeding it one final time.

title: Privilege Escalation
synopsis: After an analyst is mysteriously granted unlimited access to a global security network, she uncovers a ghost account capable of rewriting identities—and finds her own name at the top of its target list.

title: Reincarnated and It Feels So Good
synopsis: A reckless human soul returns as an iguana with memories of every past life and must use its least impressive body yet to earn the second chance it has wasted for centuries.
poster: posters/Reincarnated and It Feels So Good.png

title: Songweaver
synopsis: A gifted folk singer leaves her isolated hometown with a suitcase of family stories, discovering that the songs bringing her fame may also reveal truths her community buried.

title: Space Justice
synopsis: A rule-breaking alien detective and his impossibly by-the-book new partner pursue a fugitive across the galaxy, leaving a trail of wrecked ships and questionable jurisdiction behind them.

title: The Burning Bush
synopsis: In a kingdom swallowed by living shadow, a wandering outcast is bound to an undying flame and must carry its light across enemy lands before the last sanctuary goes dark.

title: The Flapper
synopsis: In 1925 Paris, a dazzling nightclub socialite uses her access to the elite as cover for espionage, but her latest secret could bring down both her country and the man she loves.

title: The Great Freeze
synopsis: When the catastrophic winter of 1894 threatens Florida’s farms, a determined grower rallies his divided community to save their harvest, their homes, and a legacy that cannot be frozen.

title: The Last Badge of Red Creek
synopsis: An aging marshal rides into Red Creek for one final arrest and discovers that enforcing the law will mean confronting the town he abandoned—and the son who inherited his enemies.
poster: posters/The Last Badge of Red Creek.png

title: The Painted Man
synopsis: When a freak paint spill turns an ordinary man into a viral icon, he embraces the spotlight—until the photographer who captured him claims ownership of his image and begins selling a fabricated life, forcing him to reclaim his identity from the celebrity he helped create.

title: The Wildflower Alliance
synopsis: When a creeping blight divides their enchanted garden, quiet Bramble and radiant Solara form an unlikely alliance to reunite its rival realms before the last wildflower fades.

title: Thunder Born
synopsis: A forgotten guitarist discovers that his music can summon storms, turning one final comeback tour into a battle against the force that gave him power and now wants it returned.

title: Time Paradox
subtitle: Episode -1
synopsis: A temporal agent arrives in Chicago one day before his own mission begins, racing to prevent a future mistake without becoming the paradox that causes it.

title: Wake Up Call
subtitle: The David Walker Story
synopsis: In 1829 Boston, writer and abolitionist David Walker risks his freedom and his life to circulate a defiant message that awakens a movement and terrifies a nation built on slavery.

title: Wir Tanzen Mit Dem Schicksal
subtitle: We Dance with Fate
synopsis: At an opulent masquerade in 1897, a vampire heiress promised to a powerful bloodline shares one forbidden waltz with a stranger marked for death. Before the music ends, desire becomes conspiracy—and she must choose between the immortal future arranged for her and the one man who makes eternity feel like a prison.
